purpose: Decide whether a following public SEIS Repo wave is justified by current repository evidence rather than cadence alone, without creating a package or card, activating Wave 4, claiming Swift execution, or changing the public release boundary.

followingWaveDecision.outcome: A narrowly bounded manifest-topology capability is justified for a later plan because it formalizes a reusable public static contract that the existing readiness, concurrency, and adoption packages do not own. The candidate remains unimplemented until a separate 100-step plan, risk review, and activation decision are complete.
followingWaveDecision.reviewedExecutionLimit: The prior SwiftPM result remains incomplete and unclaimed. This candidate is limited to checked-in manifest topology and must not imply SwiftPM, compiler, test, signing, simulator, device, runtime, provider, deployment, installation, or release proof.

allowedRead: one fixed checked-in Swift Package manifest

output: library and executable product to target mappings

distinctFrom.boundary: It verifies static markers, source/test presence, and platform strategy; it does not provide a reusable graph relation report for product, target, dependency, and resource mappings.
It analyzes bounded Swift source concurrency signals; it does not parse the Swift Package manifest topology.
It summarizes recorded adoption signals; it does not inspect checked-in package topology.

nonGoals: Compiling, testing, describing, resolving, or running SwiftPM packages.
Reading arbitrary paths, traversing source trees, or following symlinks.
Claiming graph validity, compiler correctness, runtime behavior, signing, installation, deployment, provider behavior, or public release.
Adding a source directory, public card, dependency, permission, network call, secret, external write, or personal marketplace access during this review.

read: one fixed checked-in Swift Package manifest

risks.description: A static package topology report could duplicate Apple readiness or be misread as a compiled SwiftPM graph.
risks.mitigation: Restrict the contract to product, target, dependency, and resource relationships; retain compiler, SwiftPM, runtime, and release claims as false.

risks.description: Selecting a later capability candidate could be mistaken for Wave 4 activation or a new public card.
risks.mitigation: Keep implementationApproved and activationApproved false, preserve candidate absence across source/catalog/matrix/marketplace, and require step 99 planning before any implementation.

risks.description: Manifest text could expose unsafe local information if future scope expands beyond the fixed checked-in file.
risks.mitigation: Use one fixed regular-file path, cap text size, refuse symlinks, return derived topology only, and retain no raw text in the evidence record.

rollback.scope: Revert this focused Wave 3 following-wave review and tracker references on the feature branch; no package, card, external state, release, or data migration exists.
